name: @equin/plugin-packages-list-bound
description: A list's bound, declared in its zod schema: cappedList / cappedRecord (a checked max) and wholeList / wholeRecord (loaded whole, with a written reason), tagged on the schema itself (zod-introspect's defineSchemaTag, stamped by clone) so the tag survives zod's clones and wrappers; listShapeOf walks (over zod-introspect's SchemaNode) every array, record, map and set a schema reaches and reports each one's bound and the bare ones, listBoundsOf refuses a bare one.
